effect_description_eng:
＜Retaliation＞ (When this Digimon is deleted after losing a battle, delete the Digimon it was battling.)
[End of Opponent's Turn] By deleting this Digimon, delete 1 of your opponent's Digimon with the lowest DP.
 [On Deletion] You may play 1 [Loogamon] or [Eiji Nagasumi] from your trash without paying the cost.
